title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode2 A Nostalgic Disc

meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whew!
That bath felt so nice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
I should massage my feet with that roller Airi told me about!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This thing really does wonders!
My feet always feel so good afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... This spot always hurts the most. I should spend a bit more time massaging it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh, it feels pretty tight.
Is it because I've been practicing so much by myself at home lately?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I feel like that's the reason I've been able to do all the tricky steps for our new song.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've learned how to do a lot of other things too, so I need to do what I can to make sure our solo show goes as well as it can.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I'm definitely still worried about our show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I feel much better now knowing that the others also felt nervous leading up to their first solo shows...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It felt really special...
And I want you to experience that incredible sensation, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Forging a deep bond with our fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I understand what Haruka meant by forging a deep bond with our fans... I mean, I felt the same way that time...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Hmm... It should be on this shelf...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Here it is!
The DVD of the first ASRUN show I went to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, that reminds me of how I used to watch this almost every day before we formed our group...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mom even said, “It's going to break if you watch it so much!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
It's been a little while, so I think I'll watch it again!

rows.Speaker: DVD Captions
rows.Line: ASRUN's Tour of Japan: “HONEY” in Tokyo at the Korakuen Dome...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right! They performed here!
I couldn't believe how big the venue was until I got there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it...
That was when I just entered junior high...)
A few years ago
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Chi, did you watch “Night-capade!” yesterday?!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
“Night-capade!”...?
You mean that show where celebrities are asked to do various challenges? I think it airs really late at night, so I haven't seen it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I told you to watch it!
Haruka was on it last night!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She did this gymnastics challenge where she went on the balance beam and the horizontal bars. It was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I made sure to record it, so I'll bring it by tomorrow! Please promise to watch it!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Okay, I will...
You really like Haruka Kiritani, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Because she's super cool!
I mean, she works so hard to learn how to do things that seem impossible! I can't help but feel inspired by her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not only that, she's an amazing singer and dancer... And just the best idol ever!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I agree with you there. I saw her dance on this one show the other day and thought that she had some really nice moves. Her core must be rock solid.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, you think so too?!
As a fellow dancer?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which means Haruka really is as amazing as I think she is! That explains why she's the #1 idol right now.
se_event_then_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Wah!
M-Minori... Something just fell from above...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Noooo! A bird dropped a present on my bag!!! I really like it too since it matches with Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Are you okay? You really do have rotten luck...
Here, use this tissue.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thanks, Chi... But why me...? Why always me...?

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
I mean, these things happen.
I really don't think you need to feel so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, I could consider this my lucky day...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because that bird hit my bag dead center. What are the odds of that? This might mean that something really good is waiting for me up ahead!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait...!
They had merch signed by Haruka herself as the viewer prize on “Night-capade!” yesterday! What if I win that?!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Well, you seem cheerful, so I guess things are gonna be okay...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: In the past, you used to get so down whenever anything like this happened. After becoming a Haruka Kiritani fan, you're Ms. Optimistic all the time now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because Haruka wouldn't let something like this get her down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've decided that I'm gonna become an idol just like Haruka, so I need to be more optimistic!

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Right. Oh, speaking of which, how'd your audition go? Didn't you send in an application to an agency or something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
I didn't even make it past the initial screening.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was ASRUN's agency too, so I was really hoping that I'd get in. I even made sure to write, “I want to become a super idol who's an amazing singer and dancer, like Haruka!”

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that's just my first attempt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The other agencies are also holding auditions, so I should be able to get into one of them as long as I cast a wide net!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
And I'm feeling really lucky right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna get straight to work on my applications when I get home♪

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Haha... Good luck...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For this part of the dance routine, I need to stretch out my hands and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Give an idol wink!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I did it!
This is amazing! It feels like I'm dancing right alongside Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I already figured out how to do the dance for this song! I think I can do it on demand now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Does this mean I have real talent...?
Do I have what it takes to become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Where did all that time go?!
It's already been twenty minutes since “Runtime with ASRUN” started!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Minori, we're home!
Did you make sure to take Samo for a walk?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mom, Dad, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And yes, I took him for a walk!
We went to the park as usual before I started doing my dance practice... No, wait, now's not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why are you so flustered?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, so... I completely forgot that Haruka's show starts at six! They're supposed to be making a big announcement today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uhh... Where'd the remote go?!
Why did it choose now to disappear?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's it hiding under your bed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Good eye, Dad!
se_event_then_2022_013

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line: <We'll be making our big announcement after we take a quick commercial break!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank goodness! I made it in time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <It's really important, so please stay tuned!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! I'll watch just like you asked me to!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Minori...
You really can't get enough of ASRUN, can you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But what's this big announcement going to be about? It's been a while since they released their last song, so... Maybe they're revealing their next one...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't wait, Samo! Isn't this just so exciting?!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Comedian MC
rows.Line:
<We appreciate your patience!
Now, for our big announcement! Haruka, if you will!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Okay. I'm happy to announce that ASRUN...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <...will be releasing our latest song, “Maidenly Honey Mustard”, and going on a tour of Japan!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A tour...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mom, they're going on tour!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
A tour?
I mean, they're idols, right? Isn't that normal? I remember seeing on an afternoon talk show the other day that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's not the point!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm in junior high now!
Doesn't that mean I'm old enough to go see one of their shows?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really need to go to learn more about becoming an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How many times do we need to go over this? Becoming an idol isn't as easy as you think it is...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you're a junior high schooler now, but I don't feel comfortable about letting you go alone to one of these shows. I mean, things have been so unsettling lately...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, Mom, please! I beg you!
I'll use my allowance to pay for my own ticket... And if you don't want me going alone, I can take Chi with me!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: You'll have Chihiro with you? That would make me feel better since she has a good head on her shoulders... But does she also like ASRUN?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Um... Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'll ask her!
So that means I can go right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
I don't see why not.
Minori's been asking about going to see ASRUN live for a long time now.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: She's also at that age where she should start experiencing more new things. I mean, she won't be able to if we keep her locked up in a cage. This might end up being an opportunity for her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Dad...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'm okay with it as long as Chihiro's also going with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: However, in return, you have to get all your homework done and take Samo out for all of his walks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Some stuff for school is really hard, but I'll manage somehow... And I'll take Samo to the North Pole if I have to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you both so much, Mom, Dad!
